research.name: Singapore management corporation (MCST) - Building (Strata Management) Act 2004, First and Second Schedules

instruments.value: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (formerly Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act 2004) - s.2 (resolution types), s.27(3) (First Schedule applies to MC meetings), s.53-53B (council), First Schedule (general meetings), Second Schedule (council/records)
instruments.note: Read the full current text on Singapore Statutes Online (page showed 'Current version as at 24 Oct 2026'). Applies to every management corporation constituted for a strata title plan (condominiums). The First Schedule was rewritten by S 406/2023 (virtual meetings) wef 1 Jul 2023.
instruments.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.2, First Schedule, Second Schedule

instruments.note: Government explainers; used only to cross-check the Act. BCA says the guides are not legal advice and do not interpret the Act. Guide 4 still describes the pre-2023 position in places (for example e-voting), so the Act text wins.
Building Maintenance (Strata Management) Regulations 2005 and the management corporation's own by-laws were NOT read.

calledBy.value: Council convenes; one AGM in every calendar year, at most 15 months after the previous AGM (first AGM: developer, within 13 months of constitution).
calledBy.note: Rule is from BCA Guide 3 s.2 citing s.26-27; s.27 itself was not separately opened (section lies outside the schedule I read).
calledBy.source: BCA Strata Management Guide 3, https://www.bca.gov.sg/publications/bmsm/others/SMG3-Preparation-for-a-General-Meeting.pdf ; Guide 4, https://www.bca.gov.sg/publications/bmsm/others/SMG4-Proceedings-of-a-General-Meeting.pdf (Guide 3 para 2.1-2.3)

noticeDays.note: Notice served at least 14 days before; meeting can be held on the 15th day or later (s.2(2)). 21 days (22nd day) if any motion needs special / 90% / unanimous / comprehensive / consensus resolution (s.2(3)-(7)). Agenda must carry the statutory AGM motions (para 1A(3)). Notice may be shortened only if the MC passes a special resolution to allow it (para 1A(6)). Max days: none stated.
noticeDays.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 1A(1), 1A(3), 1A(6); s.2(2)-(7)

noticeContent.value: Place, day, hour; each proposed motion; any other business; copy of (or online link to) last minutes; statement of accounts and auditor's report; call for council nominations; how to vote incl. by electronic means if virtual.
noticeContent.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 1A, 1B

delivery.value: Notice must be served on each subsidiary proprietor and first mortgagee on the strata roll. BCA Guide 3 lists fax, registered post (deemed served 3rd working day), email (also posted), ordinary post (4th working day), hand delivery or affixing to the lot door.
delivery.note: The delivery list is from the BCA guide citing s.129 of the Act and Interpretation Act s.2; s.129 not opened.
delivery.source: BCA Strata Management Guide 3, https://www.bca.gov.sg/publications/bmsm/others/SMG3-Preparation-for-a-General-Meeting.pdf ; Guide 4, https://www.bca.gov.sg/publications/bmsm/others/SMG4-Proceedings-of-a-General-Meeting.pdf (Guide 3 para 6.1)

calledBy.value: Council (by majority vote) or on requisition. Requisition signed by owners of at least 20% of aggregate share value, or by at least 25% of the subsidiary proprietors by number; council must convene within 6 weeks of receipt; if council does not move within 14 days the requisitionists (or one holding more than 50% of the requisitionists' voting rights) may convene, within 3 months.
calledBy.note: Para 14(1)-(3). Requisition must state the objects of the meeting and be deposited at the MC's registered address.
calledBy.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 14

noticeDays.note: Same notice rules as AGM (21 days if a special/90%/etc. resolution is on the agenda). Any SP may also require a motion to be put on the next general meeting agenda by written notice to the council secretary (para 12).
noticeDays.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 1A(1), 12; s.2

calledBy.note: Second Schedule: notice of a council meeting at least 3 days before, by notice board and/or service; minutes of a council meeting displayed within 14 days.
calledBy.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, Second Schedule para 3(2)(a), para 4(1)

noticeDays.note: Second Schedule para 4(1) (read the first words only; the delivery limbs were cut off in my extract).
noticeDays.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, Second Schedule para 4(1)

quorum.note: Quorum is met when subsidiary proprietors owning at least 30% of the aggregate share value of all lots are present in person or by proxy (para 3(2)). The chairperson alone is enough if the chairperson owns at least 30% (para 11 read with para 3).
quorum.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 3(1)-(2), 11

value.halfHourRule: If no quorum within half an hour of the appointed time, the meeting may go ahead if 2 or more subsidiary proprietors are present IN PERSON
value.notAppliesTo: an EGM convened on requisition by subsidiary proprietors
value.adjournedMeetingNotice: 14 days (displayed on notice board and served on every SP)

adjournedQuorum.note: Para 3(3)-(4) and 3A. A general meeting may be adjourned for any reason if a motion to adjourn is passed (para 3A(1)). The text gives no separate quorum for the adjourned meeting: the usual quorum rule (para 3) applies again.
adjournedQuorum.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 3(3)-(4), 3A

ordinary.value: Ordinary resolution: valid votes counted FOR are more than valid votes AGAINST, among SPs entitled to vote and present (in person/proxy). Show of hands/voting slips: one vote per lot. On a poll: by share value.
ordinary.note: s.2(2). Abstentions and unmarked/void votes are not counted as valid votes (s.2(8)). A poll is taken if any person entitled to vote demands it personally at the meeting (para 9(2)(a)).
ordinary.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.2(2), s.2(8); First Schedule para 9

value.special_resolution: at least 75% of the share value of the valid votes cast on a poll; 22nd day or later after notice
value.ninety_percent_resolution: at least 90% of share value of valid votes cast on a poll; 22nd day notice
value.unanimous: every valid vote cast supports it
value.comprehensive: after 12 weeks, at least 90% of the share value of ALL lots, on a poll
value.consensus: after 12 weeks, every SP supports in writing

special.note: s.2(3)-(7). Special and 90% resolutions are always decided on share value (para 9(2)(b)). Council members are elected by one vote per lot, and no poll is needed for an election (para 8(4)-(5)).
special.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.2(3)-(7); First Schedule para 8, 9

value.jointOwners: senior name on the strata roll wins if both vote
value.firstMortgagee: may vote instead of the SP

weightageModels.note: Para 9(1)-(4), 8(4), 2(2)-(3). Votes are cast only by SPs (or mortgagee in possession / receiver) who have paid all contributions due (para 2(1)(a); see arrears).
weightageModels.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 2, 8, 9

value.form: prescribed form in para 17(2) listing each resolution with For/Against/Abstain; signed by SP and proxy; void if SP is present
value.deadline: deposited or emailed at least 48 hours before the meeting (or the poll)
value.limitPerProxy: a proxy can represent at most 2 lots or 2% of the total number of lots (rounded down), whichever is HIGHER; extra proxies are void

proxy.note: Para 17-19. A proxy may also vote for his own lot and for several SPs separately; a proxy appointment is deemed to include the power to demand a poll.
proxy.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 17, 18, 19

value.normal: voting slips prepared by the MC, cast in person (or by a proxy)
value.poll: by share value, any person entitled may demand it, manner decided by the chair
value.election: no poll needed; one vote per lot

votingMethods.note: Para 5(1)-(3), 9, 8(5). Votes must be cast in person (physically or via virtual meeting technology) or by a proxy. No postal or advance voting is allowed for ordinary meeting votes; resolutions by consensus / comprehensive resolutions are collected in writing over 12 weeks (s.2(6)-(7)).
votingMethods.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 5, 5A, 8, 9

value.eVotingConditions: only while present at the virtual meeting; system must count accurately, be auditable, chair must declare result; for council elections the chair's declaration must be audio/video recorded

electronicVoting.note: Para 1C, 5A. Virtual-only meeting is NOT allowed unless all members who wish to participate have access to the technology, or if the MC has by ordinary resolution required physical meetings. A person on virtual technology counts as present only if verified by the secretary (or verifier) and acknowledged by the chair (para 1(2)).
electronicVoting.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 1(2), 1C, 5A

minutesDeadlineDays.note: Minutes of a general meeting must be displayed on the notice board not later than the 45th day after the meeting, and kept displayed at least 14 days (the notice board may be an online one). Minutes must record date, time, place, SPs present, who appointed proxies, proxies present, result of each vote and text of each resolution (para 10A).
minutesDeadlineDays.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, Second Schedule para 3(2)(b), 3(3), 3(2A); First Schedule para 10A

recordRetentionYears.note: not read / not verified: no retention period found in the parts of the Act I read (Second Schedule para 3 requires keeping minutes but I did not locate a number of years).

value.books of account: available for inspection at all reasonable times by an SP or mortgagee (or person authorised in writing)

memberInspectionRight.note: Second Schedule para 3(5). A printed copy of minutes/accounts must be sent without charge if requested at least 48 hours before the meeting where only an online link was given (para 1A(3A)). The Act also lists the strata roll and minutes among documents available to an applicant, but that section was not read closely.
memberInspectionRight.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, Second Schedule para 3(5); First Schedule para 1A(3A)

value.chair: chairperson of the MC presides; if absent the SPs present elect one of themselves (para 6)
value.nominations: oral at the meeting, or in writing to the secretary at least 48 hours before (s.53B(3)); candidate consent in writing 48 hours before or orally; consent can be withdrawn only by the candidate in person before the election starts (s.53B(5))
value.uncontested: if candidates are no more than the seats, they are declared elected (para 8(3))
value.tie: drawing lots in the manner the presiding person decides (s.53A(8), mixed-use)

electionRoles.note: No returning officer role in the Act. Council size is decided by the MC in general meeting, maximum 14 natural persons (s.53(1)). BCA Guide 4 Annex A describes the practice but is guidance only.
electionRoles.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.53, 53A, 53B; First Schedule para 6, 8

value.note: All council members retire at the conclusion of the next AGM and may be re-elected (s.53(4)-(5)); treasurer cannot hold office for a 3rd consecutive term (s.53(9B))

termYears.note: s.53(4), (5), (9B). Chairperson, secretary and treasurer must be three different people (s.53(9A)).
termYears.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.53

value.who: an SP, an SP's nominee (if the SP is a company), or an immediate family member nominated by an SP
value.undischarged bankrupt: eligible only if bankruptcy declared in writing at nomination
value.multi-lot owners: limits on how many nominees one owner may have on the council (s.53(8)(b), (12))

eligibility.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.53

value.voting: an SP whose contributions or other moneys are in arrears at the date of notice cannot vote unless paid at least 3 days before the meeting (except unanimous resolutions or resolutions by consensus)
value.standing: ineligible for election to council if any arrears exist on the 3rd day before the election

defaulterDisqualification.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 1A(2)(e), 2(1); s.53(7)

value.egm: 20% of aggregate share value OR 25% of the SPs by number
value.agenda motion: any single SP may require a motion on the next general meeting agenda

requisition.note: Para 14(1); para 12(1). The 10% rule for the first AGM comes from BCA Guide 3 para 2.1 citing s.26 (not opened).
requisition.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, First Schedule para 14, 12

value.writtenNomination: at least 48 hours before the meeting
value.consent: at least 48 hours before the meeting, or orally at it

nominationPeriods.note: s.53B(3)-(4). No longer nomination period is fixed by the Act; the AGM notice itself must call for nominations (para 1B).
nominationPeriods.source: Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 (SSO current version; earlier title Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act), https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/BSMA2004?WholeDoc=1, s.53B; First Schedule para 1B

notes: Voting in person: the Act requires votes to be cast in person or by proxy (para 5(1)); absentee/postal voting is not available for ordinary meeting votes.
Mixed-use developments must reserve at least one council seat per class of use (s.53A) - the product cannot yet express that.

engine.name: Singapore Building (Strata Management) Act 2004 - management corporation (condominium) general meetings

proxy_voting.reason: BSMA First Schedule paras 17-19: a subsidiary proprietor may vote by proxy and the MC cannot remove that right

recommended: Give 21 days' notice (22nd day or later) whenever ANY motion on the agenda needs a special, 90%, unanimous, comprehensive or consensus resolution (s.2(3)-(7)); 14 days is enough only if every motion is an ordinary resolution (s.2(2)).

Special and 90% resolutions and any demanded poll are counted by SHARE VALUE of the lot; an ordinary show of votes is one vote per lot; council elections are one vote per lot (First Schedule para 8(4), 9).

Proxy forms must follow the prescribed form, be signed by owner AND proxy, and reach the MC at least 48 hours before the meeting; a proxy may hold at most 2 lots or 2% of lots, whichever is higher (para 17-18).
An owner in arrears 3 days before the meeting cannot vote (except on unanimous / consensus resolutions) - publish the list of persons entitled to vote on the notice board 48 hours before (para 7).
Display minutes within 45 days for at least 14 days (Second Schedule para 3).
Written council nominations must reach the secretary 48 hours before the meeting (s.53B).
gaps: Two kinds of vote count (one vote per lot, and share value for polls / special / 90% resolutions) in the SAME meeting - the 'weightage' option is one switch for the whole event.
Notice is 14 days or 21 days depending on which resolutions are on the agenda.
Half-hour rule: if there is no quorum after 30 minutes, 2 or more owners present in person are enough (not for requisitioned EGMs).
Proxy cap is the higher of 2 lots or 2% of all lots - not a fixed number.
EGM requisition is 20% of share value OR 25% of owners by number (only one number can be stored).
Mixed-use reserved council seats (one per class of use, s.53A) and the treasurer's 3-consecutive-term ban (s.53(9B)).
Resolution by consensus / comprehensive resolution run over 12 weeks with written support after the meeting.

research.name: Hong Kong owners' corporation (OC) - Building Management Ordinance Cap. 344, Schedules 2 and 3

instruments.value: Building Management Ordinance (Cap. 344) - Schedule 3 (Meetings and Procedure of Corporation), Schedule 2 (Composition and Procedure of Management Committee), ss.30, 36A
instruments.note: Read the current consolidated text on the HK e-Legislation site (includes amendments by the Building Management (Amendment) Ordinance 2024, 20 of 2024; its corporate-owner and proxy-list rules apply to meetings noticed on or after 13 July 2025). Schedule 3 prevails over the deed of mutual covenant (Sch 3 para 8).
instruments.source: Building Management Ordinance (Cap. 344), https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap344, Sch 2, Sch 3, s.30, s.36A

instruments.note: Deed of mutual covenant (DMC) of each building, OC constitution, and the Building Management (Amendment) Ordinance 2024 transitional detail were NOT separately read. Tender / large-scale maintenance resolution thresholds under ss.20A etc. were not read.

calledBy.value: Management committee convenes. First AGM within 15 months of registration; later AGMs not earlier than 12 and not later than 15 months after the previous AGM.

noticeDays.note: Secretary must give notice to each owner (and tenants' representative) at least 14 days before, and also display the notice in a prominent place in the building 14 days before. Notice may be delivered personally, posted to last known address or left at the flat / its letter box.

noticeContent.value: Date, time and place; each resolution to be proposed and other matters to be discussed. A resolution not set out in the notice (or ancillary to one that is) has no effect.
noticeContent.note: Sch 3 para 2(1AA) and 3(7). An amended resolution may still be passed (para 3(8)).

chair.value: Chairman of the management committee; if absent the vice-chairman; if both absent a person appointed by owners present from among themselves.

calledBy.value: Management committee at any time; the chairman MUST convene a general meeting on written request of not less than 5% of the owners, within 14 days of receiving the request, and hold it within 45 days.

quorum.note: Quorum is 10% of the owners, or 20% where a resolution to dissolve the management committee under s.30 is proposed. A proxy counts as the owner being present. The text counts 'owners', so heads, not shares.

adjournedQuorum.note: Para 5A only carries over valid proxy forms (and corporate authorisations) to the adjourned meeting unless revoked or replaced. No separate adjourned-meeting quorum is stated; the 10%/20% quorum is not relaxed. A notice period for the adjourned meeting is not stated in the text I read.

ordinary.value: A matter at a meeting with a quorum is decided by a majority of the votes of the owners voting personally or by proxy; the chair has a casting vote on a tie (in addition to a deliberative vote).
ordinary.note: Sch 3 para 3(3)-(4). Some matters need other majorities in Sch 2 para 5 and the Ordinance (for example s.30 dissolution, tenders); those were not read.

special.note: not read / not verified: the Ordinance elsewhere sets higher thresholds (for example s.30 dissolution, appointment of administrator, large-scale maintenance tenders); I did not read them.

value.default: one vote per undivided share owned
value.override: the deed of mutual covenant may provide otherwise
value.coOwners: vote may be cast by a joint proxy, a co-owner chosen by them, or else the co-owner highest in the Land Registry register

weightageModels.note: Sch 3 para 3(5)-(6). Corporate flat owners: one authorised natural person (para 4A-4B).

value.form: Form 2 in Schedule 1A, signed by the owner (corporate owner: seal/chop plus signature of authorised person)
value.deadline: lodged with the secretary at least 48 hours before the meeting

proxy.note: Sch 3 para 4(1)-(5A). The secretary must issue a receipt and display a list of flats with proxies at the meeting. A proxy is treated as the owner present (para 5(2)). No cap on the number of proxies one person may hold was found.

votingMethods.note: Sch 3 para 4(1). The Schedule does not mention secret ballot, postal or advance votes; para 7 leaves the rest of the procedure to the corporation itself.

electronicVoting.note: No provision for electronic meetings or e-voting found in Sch 3 as read (2024 amendments added electronic submission of corporate authorisation notices only). Para 7 leaves procedure to the corporation.

minutesDeadlineDays.note: Certified minutes must be displayed in a prominent place within 28 days after the meeting and stay up at least 7 consecutive days; a copy must be supplied to an owner / tenants' representative / registered mortgagee on written request within 28 days.

recordRetentionYears.note: Certified minutes of general and committee meetings must be kept 6 years from certification; lodged proxy instruments 12 months after the meeting; corporate authorisation notices 3 years.

value.minutesCopy: any owner, the tenants' representative, a registered mortgagee (or their authorised person) may request a copy of certified minutes; supplied within 28 days (reasonable copying charge for hard copy, free in electronic form)

value.chair: the presiding person at the meeting draws lots on a tie
value.method: first-past-the-post: each owner may vote for up to the number of seats
value.uncontested: if candidates are not more than seats they are deemed appointed

electionRoles.note: Sch 2 para 2(3), 5(2B). No returning officer is prescribed. Chairman, secretary and treasurer are appointed by separate resolutions; vice-chairman optional.

termYears.note: Members retire at the 2nd AGM and then at every alternate AGM (Sch 2 para 5(1)); since AGMs fall 12-15 months apart, a term is roughly 2 years but no fixed year count is stated. Members hold office until new members are appointed (para 3). Re-election not barred in the text read.

value.must be: an owner (tenants' representative deemed appointed separately)
value.disqualified: undischarged bankrupt or discharged/arrangement within 5 years without paying creditors in full; imprisonment over 3 months without option of fine within 5 years
value.ceasesToBeMember: absent from 3 consecutive committee meetings without consent; removal by corporation resolution

defaulterDisqualification.note: not read / not verified: no arrears-based bar on voting or standing appears in Sch 2 / Sch 3 as read.

nominationPeriods.note: not read / not verified: no nomination period or withdrawal period is prescribed in the Ordinance text I read.

notes: Meeting rules in Sch 3 override the deed of mutual covenant (para 8).
Corporate owners: from 13 July 2025 one authorised natural person acts for the company; its proxy is revoked if that person is available (Sch 3 para 4(1A), 4A).
Retrieved 2026-10-24. Research only; not legal advice.

engine.name: Hong Kong owners' corporation - Building Management Ordinance Cap. 344 (Schedule 3 meetings)

proxy_voting.reason: Building Management Ordinance Sch 3 para 4(1) lets every owner vote by proxy, and para 8 makes Sch 3 prevail over the deed of mutual covenant

recommended: Give at least 14 days' notice AND display the notice in a prominent place in the building for the same 14 days (Sch 3 para 2).
Only resolutions set out in the notice (or ancillary to them) are effective - list every resolution in the notice (Sch 3 para 3(7)).
Proxy forms must be Form 2 and reach the secretary 48 hours before; display the list of flats with proxies at the meeting (Sch 3 para 4).
Quorum is 10% of the OWNERS (20% for a vote to dissolve the committee), with proxies counted as present (Sch 3 para 5).
AGMs must be 12 to 15 months apart (Sch 3 para 1(1)(b)).
Display certified minutes within 28 days for at least 7 days and keep them 6 years (Sch 3 para 6, s.36A).
Check the building's deed of mutual covenant: it may change the one-vote-per-share rule (Sch 3 para 3(5)(a)).
gaps: Quorum counts owners (heads) but votes are normally counted by undivided shares - the product has one 'weightage' switch.
Quorum is 20% instead of 10% for a dissolution vote (varies by agenda item).
Committee members retire every alternate AGM (about every 2 years) and the committee's size depends on the number of flats.
Corporate-owner authorised person and the secretary's public list of proxies.
Additional special thresholds elsewhere in the Ordinance (dissolution, tenders) were not read.

research.name: Malaysia - Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757): joint management body (JMB) / management corporation (MC) general meetings

instruments.value: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), s.2 (resolution definitions), s.22(2), Second Schedule (general meetings of the management corporation and its committee)
instruments.note: Read through a secondary web reproduction of the Act (lawplayer.com), not the official Gazette PDF. A search summary of Wikipedia says the Act came into force on 1 June 2015 in Peninsular Malaysia and the Federal Territory of Labuan (Sabah and Sarawak not covered) - not verified against a primary source. s.22(2) applies the Second Schedule to the JMB with modifications (for example the developer counts as one person for quorum).
instruments.source: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), Second Schedule, as reproduced at https://lawplayer.com/my/act/act-757 (secondary reproduction; official text lom.agc.gov.my not opened), s.2, s.22(2), Second Schedule

instruments.note: Strata Management (Maintenance and Management) Regulations 2015 (forms, sample notices), Strata Titles Act 1985 (Act 318), and the by-laws of each scheme were NOT read. A law-firm article (Burgie Law, 2016) summarises the same meeting rules but under the pre-2015 title and without section numbers.

calledBy.value: Committee convenes. First AGM within one month after the initial period ends; thereafter once a year with no more than 15 months between AGMs (a late AGM stays valid).
calledBy.source: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), Second Schedule, as reproduced at https://lawplayer.com/my/act/act-757 (secondary reproduction; official text lom.agc.gov.my not opened), para 10

noticeDays.note: Every proprietor gets at least 14 days' notice of any general meeting (para 12(1)). Special and unanimous resolutions: 21 days' notice (s.2); comprehensive resolution: 30 days (s.2).
noticeDays.source: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), Second Schedule, as reproduced at https://lawplayer.com/my/act/act-757 (secondary reproduction; official text lom.agc.gov.my not opened), para 12(1); s.2

noticeContent.value: Venue, date and time; each proposed resolution; each proprietor's voting rights and right to appoint a proxy. AGM notice must also attach the last AGM minutes, audited accounts with auditor's report and other matters. Motions need prior notice except amendments (para 12(2)-(4)). A proprietor may require a motion on the agenda by notice at least 7 days before (para 13). Committee posts the voter list at least 48 hours before (para 14).
noticeContent.source: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), Second Schedule, as reproduced at https://lawplayer.com/my/act/act-757 (secondary reproduction; official text lom.agc.gov.my not opened), para 12-14

calledBy.value: Committee, on its own initiative, or MUST on written requisition by proprietors holding at least one-quarter of the aggregate share units, or on the Commissioner's written direction; to be held within 6 weeks. If the committee fails to act the Commissioner may authorise someone to convene it.
calledBy.source: Strata Management Act 2013 (Act 757), Second Schedule, as reproduced at https://lawplayer.com/my/act/act-757 (secondary reproduction; official text lom.agc.gov.my not opened), para 11

recommended: Check the building's REGISTERED regulations first; the figures here are the Model Regulations that apply when nothing else is registered (Cap. 224 s.38ΚΑ).
Give 7 days' notice with place, date, time and the nature of any special business; a notice posted prominently in the building counts as delivered one day later (reg 18).
Quorum is owners of 50% of the common property; if the first meeting fails, it moves to the same day next week and then those present are the quorum (regs 20-21).
Show of hands is one vote per owner; if any owner demands a poll, votes follow the unit's share of the common property (regs 23-26).
Changing the regulations needs owners of 75% of the common property, not 75% of those present (s.38ΙΘ(2)).
An owner with unpaid contributions cannot vote (reg 31).
gaps: Show of hands is one vote per owner but a poll is by share of common property - one 'weightage' switch per event.
Majority is of votes of 'persons present and entitled to vote', modelled as 'present'; special majorities are a percentage of the whole common property.
Fallback quorum at the second meeting (any owners present) after an adjournment of exactly one week.
Committee limited to five members; a treasurer is required if more than one.
The Director of the Land Registry's power to convene a late meeting or appoint a committee.

noticeDays.note: No meeting may be held before 7 days have passed from service of the notice by registered mail (deemed served 3 days after posting in Malta, 7 days overseas), fax or other electronic means (served the next day) AND from affixing the notice on the condominium notice board.
noticeDays.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(3)-(5)

chair.value: The administrator chairs; if absent, a condominus chosen at the start. The chair has a casting vote on a tie; a non-condominus administrator has only a casting vote.
chair.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(14)

quorum.note: Quorum is a number of condomini representing two-thirds of the units; proxies have the rights of the owner they represent.
quorum.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(6), 22(13)

value.rule: If no quorum within half an hour, the meeting is adjourned to the same day next week (same time and place) or such other day as the administrator indicated in the notice; at that adjourned meeting, if there is still no quorum within half an hour, the condomini present or represented are a quorum

ordinary.value: Simple majority of the units represented during the meeting.
ordinary.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(8)

special.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(7), 24(3), 9(4)

value.votes: counted by units (decisions need a majority 'of the units represented'); co-owners of a unit name one representative; fees apportioned by share value (art 11)

weightageModels.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(7)-(12)

proxy.note: Art 22(13). A proxy has the same rights and duties as the condominus.
proxy.source: Condominium Act (Cap. 398), official consolidated PDF, https://legislation.mt/eli/cap/398/eng, article 22(13)

votingMethods.note: not read / not verified: the Act does not prescribe show of hands, ballot or poll.

Quorum is 'condomini representing two-thirds of the units' - modelled as a share of flats.
Majorities are counted on units represented (modelled as 'present').
Appointment of an administrator by arbitration where the meeting fails to appoint one.
